measurement.method: Time to first composite all-cause death, myocardial infarction, or stroke (MACCE), with independent blinded clinical event adjudication.
measurement.metric: Primary MACCE hazard ratio in all randomized participants at the initial published analysis; effect of assignment to clopidogrel versus aspirin

target.outcome_definition: Primary MACCE hazard ratio in all randomized participants at the initial published analysis; effect of assignment to clopidogrel versus aspirin

time_point_or_window.description: Initial published primary analysis, database locked October 31, 2024, from randomization to first MACCE; reported Methods censor event-free observations at last known contact or 3 years, whichever first. Table 2 also describes the overall study period; preserve that wording and do not replace this HR with the 3-year Kaplan-Meier risk.

reported.analysis_population: All 5506 randomized participants analyzed in assigned groups: 2752 clopidogrel, 2754 aspirin; intention-to-treat. This does not assert complete follow-up. No baseline subgroup.

endpoint.name: Major adverse cardiac and cerebrovascular events*

relation_rationale: This prospectively fixed published primary Table 2 MACCE HR is supported by article pages 1, 3–6, independently of archived answers. The composite definition is death from any cause, myocardial infarction or stroke (Table 2 footnote), with clinical presentation and centre stratification (Methods). Assignment/ITT and the primary Cox HR are retained; 3-year KM percentages and PP sensitivity are separate results. Table 2 overall-period and Methods event-free 3-year censoring wording remain explicit rather than being silently reconciled.

applicability.rationale: Article Methods describes individually randomized parallel clopidogrel and aspirin groups, stratified by presentation and centre.
